hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, os, subprocess, sys
inp = json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT', '{}'))
cmd = inp.get('command', '')
if 'git' in cmd and 'commit' in cmd:
    staged = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    if '.env' in staged.splitlines():
        print('BLOCKED: .env is staged — remove it before committing: git restore --staged .env')
        sys.exit(2)
"
